modelNotes: Assists Board 1.0 uses season assists, last 5 assists, last 10 assists, expected minutes, minutes confidence, usage, position role, and recent assist trend.
Assists Board 2.0 adds minutes scaling, opponent assist rank, pace, rest, teammate absence redistribution, volatility, and floor/ceiling ranges.
No odds or betting lines are used.

injury.shortComment: James (back) is questionable for Thursday's game against the Raptors, Kyle Neubeck of AllPHLY.com reports.
injury.detail: The 76ers are considering giving the future Hall of Famer the night of Thursday. Dean Wade and Kentavious Caldwell-Pope would soak up more playing time in the frontcourt if James ends up sitting out.

injury.shortComment: Embiid (foot) is listed as questionable for Thursday's game against Toronto, Adam Aaronson of PhillyVoice.com reports.
injury.detail: Embiid is at risk of missing his third game of the 2026-27 campaign. With Adem Bona (back) and Dominick Barlow (back) both sidelined, Philadelphia may turn to Jabari Walker to handle things at the five if Embiid doesn't suit up versus the Raptors.

injury.shortComment: Diabate (quadriceps) is listed as probable for Thursday's game against the Suns.
injury.detail: Diabate is expected to return from a two-game absence Thursday, which would leave fewer minutes available for Ryan Kalkbrenner. Through nine regular-season games, Diabate has averaged 8.9 points, 9.1 rebounds, 2.0 assists, 1.6 steals and 0.9 blocks in 28.8 minutes per tilt.

injury.shortComment: Johnson (shin) is listed as probable for Thursday's game against Minnesota.
injury.detail: Johnson is expected to return from a one-game absence due to a left shin contusion. The rookie's return would leave fewer minutes available for the likes of Santi Aldama and Caleb Martin.

injury.shortComment: Jackson-Davis (illness) has been ruled out for Wednesday's game against the Celtics, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.
injury.detail: Jackson-Davis is under the weather and will sit out the front end of this back-to-back set. If Collin Murray-Boyles (illness) joins Jackson-Davis on the inactive list, Jamison Battle and Kyle Anderson would likely see increased burn.
